first_impression_without_control_labels: A close, personal greenhouse work portrait. The face and modest uneven smile attract attention first; each hand then leads to a different protective job, while wet glass, an open trough and receiving water make the scene inhabited and intelligible. Natural plant greens, dusty canvas and clay contrast with the bright water route.
visible_story: A paper seed packet and loose seeds rest on an inverted clay vessel at the less wet side of the bench. The other hand holds a trough underneath roof drips, and water leaves it into a pail. These present relationships support the impression of protecting the seeds; an actual preceding storm or successful future planting is not established.
